ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity overall, with approximately 15% high-intensity white pixels distributed across a 85% low-intensity black/dark-gray substrate.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Widespread high-intensity white annular and circular blobs (mottling) distributed across both lobes, with extreme concentrations at the distal tips and lower leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 48 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of 1:5 relative to the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, ranging from 2-6 pixels in peak-to-valley depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve along the upper boundary of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular high-contrast pixel rings scattered globally across the fluke surface, most notably in the lower third of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical high-intensity linear disruption visible on the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, irregularly shaped three-dimensional pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the outer edges and tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of protruding white calcified structures on the right lobe tip, significantly altering the expected geometric perimeter of the fluke.
